notes: Fictional relation insert (ABox; was biology-insert-0004 before the insert rebalance): real animals in a made-up relation, catalogued as symmetric. Every derived query is determinate (nothing stored about the relation competes): two use the symmetry stated in the prompt, two reach real knowledge about the hippopotamus through the edit (composition).
